notes: The literal 5 at views.py:406 (len(current_player_tiles) >= 5) and BingoBoard.tsx:58 (completedCount >= 5) represents a MINIMUM COMPLETED TILES THRESHOLD — not a count of winning lines. On the 3×3 board (9 positions), check_bingo_lines() detects any completed line of 3 positions, but the >= 5 guard is a deliberate design gate before bingo resolution runs. The serializers call check_bingo_lines without this guard, confirming the guard is a game-flow optimization/design choice, not a technical necessity. Named BINGO_LINE_COUNT per the brief's convention despite the nuance, with an explanatory comment.
